meta_description: Powell's Gardening & Landscaping brings professional garden design, maintenance and landscaping to Birmingham homes. Expert local service, fair pricing. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Birmingham Gardener — 15+ Years Transforming Gardens
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete landscaping projects, Powell's handles every job with attention to detail and genuine care for your outdoor space.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up, seasonal maintenance, or a full garden redesign, we handle it all with expertise and genuine care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, and border maintenance keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We tailor a schedule that suits your property and budget.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Full garden redesigns, from patio installations to raised beds and water features. We listen to your vision and turn it into a space you'll actually use and enjoy.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your space. We'll clear, tidy, and prepare your garden for whatever comes next—whether that's replanting or a full renovation project.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Beds
services.desc: Colourful borders and seasonal displays tailored to your soil and aspect. We select plants that thrive in Birmingham's climate and require sensible maintenance.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Professional pruning, deadheading, and removal of diseased branches. We keep your woody plants healthy, safe, and shaped to suit your garden design.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: New patios, pathways, and raised planters built to last. Quality materials and proper drainage mean your outdoor living area stays functional and beautiful for years.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love helping neighbours transform neglected gardens into spaces they're proud of.
about_para_1: Powell's Gardening & Landscaping has been serving Birmingham homes and businesses for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a reliable local team that now handles everything from routine maintenance to ambitious landscaping projects. We've built our reputation on showing up on time, doing the job properly, and treating every garden as if it's our own.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we're fair with pricing, and we actually know how to make gardens work in the Midlands climate. We're not interested in quick cash jobs—we want to build relationships with people who care about their outdoor spaces. That's why so many of our clients have been with us for five years or more.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Gardeners Say About Powell's

reviews.text: Had an absolute jungle of a garden. Powell's came in, cleared the lot, and then helped us design something we actually wanted to spend time in. Three months on and it looks incredible. Friendly lads, honest pricing, no faffing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Powell's for two years now. They do the maintenance, handle the seasonal planting, and just get on with it. Never had to chase them or worry about the work. That's worth a lot when you're busy.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: New patio done last spring. Perfect. Did a few tweaks to the beds too. Professional job, materials are holding up brilliantly, and they left the site spotless. Rang back in summer just to check everything was settling well. Will definitely hire them again.
reviews.author: David P.
